prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
ai_overview_text:
Top health insurance brokers in the Kansas City metro area include AIS Health Insurance Advisors (led by Travis Allen, specializing in ACA Marketplace and Medicare), Benefit Services (led by Shawn Moulin, focusing on individual, family, and small business plans at zero extra cost), and BBS Insurance (BBB A+-accredited with a 5.0 Google rating for individual and group coverage). www.health-insurance-kansas-city.com +2
Location: Overland Park, KS (serving the entire Kansas City metro)
Focus: Independent guidance for Medicare Advantage, Medigap, Part D, ACA Marketplace individual and family plans, and small business group plans.
Carriers Compared: Cigna, Aetna, Kaiser, Allstate, and others with no call-center pressure. AIS Health Insurance Advisors
Contact: Shawn Moulin (913-341-9393 x2)
Focus: Individual, family, and small business health insurance brokerage.
Cost: Free to the client; zero extra cost compared to the public Marketplace with assistance on monthly subsidies. www.health-insurance-kansas-city.com
Locations: North Kansas City, MO, Lawson, MO, and Overland Park, KS
Focus: Marketplace/private plans, small-team group health (2–50 employees), and Medicare.
Rating: BBB A+ accredited with a 5.0-star rating across dozens of client reviews. BBS Insurance Inc.
Contact: 816-436-2622 (Operating since 1993)
Focus: Medicare enrollment, ACA Marketplace plans, dental, and life insurance.
Credentials: Marketplace Elite Circle of Champions and Aetna Frontrunner. Jeff David Insurance
Cost: Independent health insurance brokers are paid directly by insurance carriers, meaning their help costs you $0 out of pocket (your plan rates are identical whether you use a broker or enroll alone). www.health-insurance-kansas-city.com +1
Scope: Make sure the broker is licensed in both Missouri and Kansas if you live on one side of state lines and see doctors on the other. BBS Insurance Inc. +1
Specialty: Choose an individual/family broker if you are buying off the ACA Exchange or turning 65 (Medicare), or a commercial/group broker (such as HUB International or Mylo) if you are shopping for a company workforce. HUB International +3
